title: WorkPulse performance.goal_cancelled v1
description: A draft or active employee goal was cancelled; cancellation is terminal. Identifiers and the state only — goal titles and descriptions are sensitive and never leave the database (`.ai/security.md`).

employee_id.description: Employee the goal belongs to — the subject (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012).

status.description: Terminal goal state; cancellation is allowed from `draft` or `active`.
